title.narrative: Guangxi Regional Cooperation and Integration Promotion Investment Program - Tranche 2

description.narrative: The second tranche of the multitranche financing facility (MFF) will cover major investments of the MFF, including investments in border-connectivity and border economic zones (BEZ). In line with the framework financing agreement, those investments strongly support Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region's (GZAR) Strategy and Action Plan for participation in the Greater Mekong Subregion (GMS) Program, aiming to deepen economic cooperation and integration with ASEAN member countries.

Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Apr 2020: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50050/50050-004-rp-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Jul 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50050/50050-004-sddr-en_5.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Mar 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50050/50050-004-smr-en_8.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Project generally on track. As of 20 September 2023, the cumulative contract award reached $144.4 million or 80.2% of the net loan amount, and cumulative disbursement reached $115.4 million or 64.1% of the net loan amount.
